name: complete_day
description: Marks every Planned meal of one day in the caller's diary as Done. Done and Modified meals are left as they are. Returns how many meals changed; 0 on a repeat.

name: complete_meal
description: Marks one meal in the caller's diary as eaten exactly as planned (status Done). Already Done stays Done. A Modified meal is refused: if the user now ate it as planned, call reset_meal first.

name: create_product
description: Saves a new product in the caller's catalog, with the same rules as the app. Nutrition is per 100 g; leave out values you do not know, never send zero for unknown. Retry with the same operationKey and fields to get the original product back instead of a duplicate; a new product needs a new key.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key for this product, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name.description: Product name, unique in the caller's catalog.

unit.description: Default unit: g, ml or piece.

caloriesPer100g.description: Energy in kcal per 100 g, if known.

proteinPer100g.description: Protein in grams per 100 g, if known.

carbsPer100g.description: Carbohydrates in grams per 100 g, if known.

fatPer100g.description: Fat in grams per 100 g, if known.

fiberPer100g.description: Fibre in grams per 100 g, if known.

densityGramsPerMl.description: Grams per millilitre, needed to measure it in volume units, if known.

gramPerPiece.description: Grams per piece, needed for the piece unit, if known.

visibility.description: Private or Household; Household when omitted.

name: create_recipe
description: Saves a new recipe in the caller's catalog from products the caller can see, with the same rules as the app. Ingredient amounts are for the whole recipe; servings says how many portions they make. Retry with the same operationKey and fields to get the original recipe back instead of a duplicate; a new recipe needs a new key.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key for this recipe, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name.description: Recipe name, unique in the caller's catalog.

servings.description: Portions the ingredient amounts make; at least 1.

productId.description: A product the caller can see, from search_products or create_product.

amount.description: Quantity for the whole recipe (all servings); must be positive.

unit.description: Unit of the amount, e.g. g, ml, piece, tbsp, cup.

prepTimeMinutes.description: Preparation time in minutes, if known.

visibility.description: Private or Household; Household when omitted.

name: delete_planned_meal
description: Removes one meal from the caller's diary, also one already marked as eaten, which drops it from the day's nutrition totals. There is no undo: confirm with the user first. Repeating the call after a successful delete reports not found; the meal is already gone.

name: delete_product
description: Deletes a product the caller may edit (their own, or a household product as an adult of that household), with the same rules as the app. It disappears from search; recipes that use it keep the ingredient line but show it as Unknown and without its nutrition; meals already in the diary keep showing it. There is no undo: confirm with the user first. Repeating the call after a successful delete reports not found; the product is already gone.

productId.description: Product id from search_products or get_product.

name: delete_recipe
description: Deletes a recipe the caller may edit (their own, or a household recipe as an adult of that household), with the same rules as the app. It disappears from search and can no longer be planned; meals already planned or eaten keep showing it. There is no undo: confirm with the user first. Repeating the call after a successful delete reports not found; the recipe is already gone.

recipeId.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or get_recipe.

name: delete_water_intake
description: Removes one drink from the caller's log, lowering that day's total. There is no undo: confirm with the user first. Repeating the call after a successful delete reports not found; the drink is already gone.

name: delete_weight_entry
description: Deletes one weigh-in from the caller's weight log; the profile's current weight falls back to the latest remaining entry, or becomes unknown. There is no undo: confirm with the user first. Repeating the call after a successful delete reports not found; the entry is already gone.

name: execute_plan_import
description: Imports a previewed plan in one all-or-nothing transaction: new products and recipes plus every planned meal (never marked eaten). Pass the exact plan and options you previewed, the previewToken, and a new operationKey. If anything changed since the preview, nothing is written and you must preview again. If the response is lost, call again with the same operationKey and plan to get the original result instead of importing twice. Run one import at a time: two different imports in parallel can both fill the same free slots.

plan.description: Exactly the plan that was previewed.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key for this import, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse it only to retry this same import.

appendToOccupiedSlots.description: The same appendToOccupiedSlots value used for the preview.

name: get_diet_context
description: Returns the caller's diet profile, daily goal and meal slots, plus a list of setup still missing in the app. Call it before planning meals; it never creates or changes anything.

name: get_hydration
description: Returns the caller's hydration settings (daily water target, glass size, whether tracking is on; null until set) and the drinks logged on one day with their total, all in millilitres.

name: get_meal_entries
description: Lists the caller's planned and eaten meals between two dates (inclusive, at most 31 days), ordered by date and slot. Use it to find occupied slots before planning.

to.description: Last day, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, at most 30 days after from.

name: get_nutrition_summary
description: Per-day calorie and macro totals of everything planned or eaten by the caller between two dates (inclusive, at most 31 days). Modified meals count what was actually eaten; unknown product values count as zero. Days without meals are omitted.

to.description: Last day, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, at most 30 days after from.

name: get_product
description: Returns one product the caller can see. Nutrition is per 100 g; null means unknown, never zero.

productId.description: Product id from search_products or a recipe ingredient.

name: get_recipe
description: Returns one recipe the caller can see, with instructions, servings, ingredients and nutrition per serving.

name: get_weight_entries
description: Lists the caller's weigh-ins (kilograms, one per day) oldest first, optionally between two dates (inclusive). Leave both dates out for the whole log.

from.description: First day, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, if any.

to.description: Last day, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, if any.

name: get_weight_prediction
description: Estimates from the caller's profile what eating a given number of kcal a day would do: BMR, TDEE, daily deficit (negative is a surplus), weekly weight change in kg, the date the target weight would be reached, and BMI now and at target. The same calculation as the app; an estimate, not medical advice. Needs date of birth, gender, height, current weight and activity level in the profile.

dailyCalorieTarget.description: Planned daily intake in kcal, e.g. the goal's daily calorie target.

name: log_water_intake
description: Adds one drink to the caller's log for a day, in millilitres (a glass is the configured glass size from get_hydration). Each call adds another drink: retry with the same operationKey and fields to get the original entry back instead of counting it twice; a new drink needs a new key.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key for this drink, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse it only to retry this same call.

date.description: Calendar day the drink counts towards, ISO yyyy-MM-dd.

name: log_weight
description: Records the caller's weight in kilograms for a day, not in the future. A day holds one weigh-in: logging a day that already has one replaces it, so a retry never adds a second entry. Also sets the profile's current weight, so the caller needs a profile first (set_profile). Returns the entry id and whether it was new.

date.description: Calendar day of the weigh-in, ISO yyyy-MM-dd; today or earlier.

weightKg.description: Weight in kilograms (convert from lb or st first); more than 0, at most 999.

name: override_meal
description: Records that the caller ate something other than the plan for one meal (status Modified): a replacement recipe, individual products, or both, never neither. Replaces any earlier override of that meal. The day's nutrition then counts what was actually eaten. Recipes and products must be ones the caller can see.

actualRecipeId.description: Recipe eaten instead of the planned one, from search_recipes; omit when only products were eaten.

actualProducts.description: Products eaten; may be empty when a recipe is given.

productId.description: A product the caller can see, from search_products or create_product.

unit.description: Unit of the amount, e.g. g, ml, piece, tbsp, cup.

name: plan_meal
description: Plans one meal in the caller's diary: a recipe the caller can see, in one of their meal slots (ids from get_diet_context) on a day. A slot can hold more than one meal; check get_meal_entries first so you do not plan a duplicate. Retry with the same operationKey and fields to get the original meal back instead of a second one; a new meal needs a new key.

operationKey.description: Idempotency key for this meal, 8-128 characters (a UUID works). Reuse it only to retry this same call.

recipeId.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or get_recipe.

servings.description: Servings of the recipe; more than 0, fractions allowed.

mealTime.description: Time overriding the slot default, HH:mm, if any.

sequenceOrder.description: Order among meals in the same slot, if it matters.

name: preview_plan_import
description: Checks a meal plan (products, recipes and dated meals, at most 31 days and 250 meals) and describes what importing it would create, reuse and plan, without changing anything. Names resolve against the caller's own catalog, ignoring case. Every problem has a JSON path such as schedule[4].meals[1].recipe. Occupied slots are conflicts unless appendToOccupiedSlots is true. When the plan can be imported, the result carries a previewToken valid for 30 minutes: show the preview to the user and pass the token to execute_plan_import once they agree.

plan.description: The plan in the import file format: products (nutrition per 100 g, omit unknown values), recipes (ingredients by product name, amounts for the whole recipe) and schedule (ISO dates, meal type = one of the caller's meal slots, recipe by name).

appendToOccupiedSlots.description: Allow meals in slots that already have planned meals.

name: reset_meal
description: Returns one meal in the caller's diary to Planned, discarding that it was eaten and any override. Already Planned stays Planned.

name: search_products
description: Searches products the caller can see by name. Nutrition is per 100 g; null means unknown, never zero.

query.description: Text the name must contain; omit to list everything.

name: search_recipes
description: Searches recipes the caller can see by name, with servings, ingredients and nutrition per serving.

query.description: Text the name must contain; omit to list everything.

name: set_goals
description: Saves the caller's daily nutrition goal, creating it on first use. Replaces every field: values you leave out become unset, so read get_diet_context first and send back what should stay. get_weight_prediction shows what a calorie target would do to weight.

dailyCalorieTarget.description: Daily energy target in kcal, if any.

proteinGrams.description: Daily protein in grams, if any.

carbsGrams.description: Daily carbohydrates in grams, if any.

fatGrams.description: Daily fat in grams, if any.

fiberGrams.description: Daily fibre in grams, if any.

name: set_profile
description: Saves the caller's diet profile, creating it on first use. Replaces every field: values you leave out become unknown, so read get_diet_context first and send back what should stay. Height in cm, weights in kg.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, if known.

gender.description: Male, Female or Other, if known.

currentWeightKg.description: Current weight in kg, if known.

targetWeightKg.description: Target weight in kg, if any.

activityLevel.description: Sedentary, LightlyActive, ModeratelyActive, VeryActive or ExtraActive, if known.

name: update_hydration_config
description: Saves the caller's hydration settings, creating them on first use and replacing all three values afterwards. Changes settings only; logged drinks stay as they are.

glassSizeMl.description: Size of one glass in millilitres, 50-2000.

trackWaterIntake.description: Whether the app tracks water intake for the caller.

name: update_planned_meal
description: Replaces every field of one meal in the caller's diary: day, slot, recipe, servings, note, time and order. Fields you leave out are cleared, so read the meal first with get_meal_entries and send back what should stay. Changing the recipe needs one the caller can see. Whether the meal was eaten is kept; use the consumption tools for that.

slotId.description: Meal slot id from get_diet_context or get_meal_entries.

recipeId.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or get_meal_entries.

servings.description: Servings of the recipe; more than 0, fractions allowed.

mealTime.description: Time overriding the slot default, HH:mm, if any.

sequenceOrder.description: Order among meals in the same slot, if it matters.

name: update_product
description: Replaces every field of a product the caller may edit (their own, or a household product as an adult of that household), with the same rules as the app. Fields you leave out become unknown, so read the product first with get_product and send back what should stay. Nutrition is per 100 g; never send zero for unknown. Recipes and meals that use the product see the new values.

productId.description: Product id from search_products or get_product.

name.description: Product name, unique in the caller's catalog.

unit.description: Default unit: g, ml or piece.

caloriesPer100g.description: Energy in kcal per 100 g, if known.

proteinPer100g.description: Protein in grams per 100 g, if known.

carbsPer100g.description: Carbohydrates in grams per 100 g, if known.

fatPer100g.description: Fat in grams per 100 g, if known.

fiberPer100g.description: Fibre in grams per 100 g, if known.

densityGramsPerMl.description: Grams per millilitre, needed to measure it in volume units, if known.

gramPerPiece.description: Grams per piece, needed for the piece unit, if known.

visibility.description: Private or Household; omit to keep the current one. Only the creator may change it.

name: update_recipe
description: Replaces every field and the whole ingredient list of a recipe the caller may edit (their own, or a household recipe as an adult of that household), with the same rules as the app. Fields and ingredients you leave out are removed, so read the recipe first with get_recipe and send back what should stay. Ingredient amounts are for the whole recipe; servings says how many portions they make. New ingredients must be products the caller can see. Planned and eaten meals that use the recipe see the new version.

recipeId.description: Recipe id from search_recipes or get_recipe.

name.description: Recipe name, unique in the caller's catalog.

servings.description: Portions the ingredient amounts make; at least 1.

ingredients.description: The complete ingredient list; at least one line.

productId.description: A product the caller can see, from search_products or create_product.

amount.description: Quantity for the whole recipe (all servings); must be positive.

unit.description: Unit of the amount, e.g. g, ml, piece, tbsp, cup.

prepTimeMinutes.description: Preparation time in minutes, if known.

visibility.description: Private or Household; omit to keep the current one. Only the creator may change it.
